interpretation: This is 1 of N=28 similar configurations run against this ticker/strategy. Adjusting for that search — and for this run's own sample size (2128 days), skew, and kurtosis — there is an estimated 36% probability that this strategy's true long-run Sharpe ratio exceeds 1.05, the Sharpe you'd expect from the best of 28 equally-skilled, zero-edge trials by chance alone. (Before accounting for the number of trials searched, PSR-vs-zero was 100%.) This is not a p-value or a guarantee — it is the model's best point estimate of the strategy's true statistical edge, not a certainty.
